pages.quiz:
INTEGRATED SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Curved mirrors? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Curved mirrors.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Curved mirrors.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Curved mirrors.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Curved mirrors.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water hardness? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water hardness.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water hardness.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water hardness.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water hardness.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Reproduction in plants? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Reproduction in plants.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Reproduction in plants.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Reproduction in plants.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Reproduction in plants.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structure of the atom? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Structure of the atom.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structure of the atom.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structure of the atom.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structure of the atom.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Interdependence of Life? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Interdependence of Life.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on The Interdependence of Life.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Interdependence of Life.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Interdependence of Life.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Interdependence of Life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Curved mirrors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Structure of the atom and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Metals and Alloys and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Glucose and oxygen

2. C — newton (N)

3. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Curved mirrors.

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water hardness.

6. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Reproduction in plants.

7. A — Ice melting to water

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structure of the atom.

9. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

10. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Interdependence of Life.

12. B — 100 °C
